name: Automate native desktop application data entry
summary: Data entry into a Windows, macOS, or Linux desktop application - demonstrated once by your team through the native interface, compiled, and replayed with per-record parameters. The runtime resolves targets from native accessibility evidence plus retained visuals.
evidenceNote: Evidence in progress. The native execution surface is described on the product surfaces page, but we have not yet published per-workflow trial counts for a desktop-application template. This card makes no performance claim; when qualified evidence exists it will be published here with the same structure as the proven templates.

provenance.label: Execution surfaces (browser in production today; desktop through customer-controlled qualification)

install.note: Installs the OpenAdapt launcher, compiler, and capture capability.
